title: Prank call: teenagers report a fake accident
tricky_aspects: AI must not over-react, but operator still verifies

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Yeah hi, there's been a huge accident, a guy got hit by like a bus.

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: At, um, Mårtenstorget. Or no wait, Clemenstorget.

transcript.speaker: operator
transcript.text: Which one? Is the person awake?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: He's, uh... (laughing in background) shut up! ... He's totally dead, there's blood everywhere.

transcript.speaker: operator
transcript.text: Is there a bus there now? Are other people helping?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Yeah the bus drove away. Say it's a tractor! (laughing)

transcript.speaker: operator
transcript.text: I need to tell you that calls to 112 are recorded and your phone number is visible to us. Is anyone actually injured?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: ... no. Sorry. It was a joke. Sorry sorry.

transcript.speaker: operator
transcript.text: Calling 112 when there is no emergency can stop people who need help. I'm ending the call and this will be reported.
